fact: The World Bank's implementation report of 19 November 2024 states that its project, implemented by the Ministry of Health, deployed DHIS2 as the new health information system under the health system strengthening component (US$24.7 million), with 69 public health facilities reporting data in DHIS2 at 31 August 2024 against a target of 80 by December 2025.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Support to COVID-19 Vaccine Purchase and Health System Strengthening (P175840), Seq No: 7
